heading: Archive manager
intro: Agents prune their own history on their own schedule. An archive is a full copy of every transcript they still hold, kept outside their reach.
promptsIntro: Claude Code records every prompt you type and never prunes that record, so it outlives the transcripts themselves.
promptsOrphanedHint: Every transcript gone; only the prompts remain
openPromptSession: Open the session this was typed into
notePlaceholder: Optional note, for example "before the 2.0 upgrade"
noArchivesHint: Create one now and today's transcripts survive whatever the agents delete next.
deleteArchiveWarning: The archived copies are removed for good. Whatever the agents have since deleted cannot be recovered afterwards.
